post.description: Post one top-level daily digest to #mentioned. Use only for DAILY_DIGEST or an explicitly authorized setup delivery test. Check result.ok is true and save result.ts before marking delivered. Never use this for background scan notifications or ordinary Slack replies.

200.description: Slack response. HTTP 200 alone does not prove delivery: inspect ok, error, channel and ts.
